Context: 3. Half Pay Leave

2. From 1-1-1986, half pay leave is credited in advance at the rate of 10 days-on the 1st of January and tstof July every year. The advance credit for the half-year in which a Government servant is appointed will be at the rate of % days for each completed calendar month of service he is likely to render in the half-year in which he is appointed.
